projects.title: Client work & selected projects.

pizzaGo.name: Pizza Go
pizzaGo.description: A smart pizza-ordering experience connected to an automated preparation system. It connects customer ordering and payment with a queue of instructions for ESP32-controlled hardware.
pizzaGo.implementation: Pizza customization, Stripe test payments, PostgreSQL order storage, MQTT communication, machine heartbeat monitoring, and order tracking.

case.problem: Online ordering must connect to the sequence of operations in an automated preparation machine.
case.architecture: Web client → Express / PostgreSQL → order queue → MQTT / ESP32; Stripe handles test payments.
case.contribution: Designed the system and programmed two ESP32 controllers for linear actuators, stepper motors, relays, a conveyor belt and a sauce pump, integrated with the backend.
case.challenge: Coordinated production with a finite-state machine and heartbeat monitoring; debugged hardware, firmware and communication, and tested the complete system.
case.result: An integrated graduation-project workflow from pizza customization to preparation-status tracking.

ideasTracker.name: Ideas Tracker
ideasTracker.description: An idea workspace that turns text and voice notes into organized ideas, with AI assistance, mind maps, and communities for sharing and discussing them.
ideasTracker.implementation: Provider-based view models, SQLite for local ideas, PostgreSQL synchronization, speech-to-text, and AI-powered idea enhancement.

case.problem: Ideas captured in scattered text and voice notes need a place to develop and discuss them.
case.architecture: Web version: Web Speech API, OpenAI and Firebase. Available Flutter codebase: Provider, SQLite, PostgreSQL and AI services.
case.contribution: Built voice-based idea capture and AI organization; the linked repository presents the Flutter implementation with local storage and community features.
case.challenge: Coordinating local ideas and remote synchronization alongside voice input and community updates.
case.result: A Flutter codebase with idea editing, AI enhancement, mind maps and community discussions.

qvista.name: QVista AI
qvista.description: Smart Jerusalem tourism platform built for a hackathon, combining RAG-based personalized recommendations, AI-powered landmark recognition, and a "Hidden Jerusalem" feature that surfaces stories and places beyond the usual map.

coffeeLab.name: Coffee Lab
coffeeLab.description: Flutter mobile application developed using MVVM and Clean Architecture principles, focusing on scalable mobile development and maintainable code structure.

projects.intro: Freelance projects for real business needs, alongside my work in AI applications and connected systems.

power.name: Power — Engineering & Electrical Solutions
power.description: A multilingual website and product catalog for an engineering and electrical solutions company, covering industrial and residential electricity, solar energy, and IoT services.
power.scope: React website, product catalog & administration API
power.implementation: Arabic, English and Hebrew layouts; searchable products and categories; an administration interface and Excel import with images. Built with React, Vite, Hono and Cloudflare D1.

case.problem: A company needs a clear way to present its services and maintain a multilingual product catalog.
case.architecture: React / Vite → Hono API → Cloudflare D1; images in Backblaze B2.
case.contribution: Freelance development of the company website and its catalog and administration workflow.
case.challenge: Supporting RTL and LTR layouts and importing product data and embedded images from Excel.
case.result: A published company website with service discovery, product search and a content administration workflow.

inverter.name: Inverter Control
inverter.tag: FREELANCE / WITH POWER, FOR RIFT VALLEY
inverter.description: A web-based system for monitoring and controlling an ESP32-connected inverter, connecting the operator interface to the device through a Node.js backend and MQTT.
inverter.scope: Web interface, backend integration & IoT communication
inverter.implementation: Live status over WebSocket, tracked control commands, role-based access, and PostgreSQL-backed command and audit logs.

case.problem: Operators need a web interface to observe device status and follow the outcome of remote commands.
case.architecture: Browser → Node.js / Express → PostgreSQL + MQTT → ESP32; WebSocket returns live updates.
case.contribution: Built the inverter backend with MQTT over TLS, HttpOnly authentication cookies, role-based access, audit logs and command acknowledgement validation.
case.challenge: Tracking command acknowledgements, timeouts and offline devices while separating operator and administrator access.
case.result: An implemented control workflow with command history, device status and audit logging.
